scenario: The same charge appearing twice across two import sources (scenario-analysis.md #13, revised 2026-08 per ADR-0010 — external_reference is now a real schema field, not an informal convention)

expected_outcome.detection_basis: Same external_reference (UTR), same amount, timestamps within seconds — deterministic dedup per docs/domain/invariants.md #10, matched WITHOUT requiring account_id to match (these two payments are on different Account rows, account_hdfc_savings vs account_hdfc_upi, precisely because a bank-CSV capture and a UPI-export capture of the same real-world UPI transaction land under different Account types in this schema — see docs/decisions/0010-payment-external-reference-fields.md's amendment). Prior to ADR-0010 this fixture used an informal 'reference' field with no backing schema column; external_reference/reference_type/source_system are now real payments columns (docs/architecture/database-design.md).
